transcript: Welcome to the shiny Robot Workshop, Ava! Let's help our metal friends get ready for the big parade. Look at all these friendly robots! Some have round heads and others have square ones. We need to see how many there are altogether to make sure no one is left behind. Let's count them up! Oh no! We have ten shiny wrenches but twelve robots. Do we have enough for everyone, or are we missing some? Let's compare our tools to our robot friends to find out the difference! Great job, Ava! Now, can you help me count exactly how many parts we need to fix the next robot?
